setup: CREATE TABLE l(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,k INTEGER);CREATE TABLE r(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,k INTEGER);INSERT INTO l VALUES(1,1),(2,2),(3,-9223372036854775808);INSERT INTO r VALUES(1,1),(2,2),(3,3);

cases.sql: SELECT abs(a.k),a.id,b.id FROM l a JOIN r b ON a.id=b.id;
SELECT abs(a.k),a.id,b.id FROM l a JOIN r b ON a.id=b.id ORDER BY a.id;
SELECT abs(a.k),a.id,b.id FROM l a JOIN r b ON a.id=b.id ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;
SELECT a.id,b.id FROM l a FULL JOIN r b ON abs(a.k)=b.k;
SELECT a.id,b.id FROM l a LEFT JOIN r b ON abs(a.k)=b.k LIMIT 1;
SELECT a.id,b.id FROM l a JOIN r b ON a.id=b.k+1;
SELECT not_a_function(a.k) FROM l a JOIN r b ON a.id=b.id LIMIT 0;
